title: NEBNext® Ultra™ II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina®
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext® Ultra™ II DNA Library Prep Kit

This protocol performs the [NEBNext® Ultra™ II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina®](https://www.neb.com/products/e7645-nebnext-ultra-ii-dna-library-prep-kit-for-illumina#Protocols,%20Manuals%20&%20Usage). The protocol includes a fully automated End Repair PCR step on the Opentrons Thermocycler. Up to 24 samples can be processed in one protocol run without the need to replenish tipracks or change out labware. ---
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files (.json extensions) if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App's Protocol tab, upload your protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips.
